name: k8s-gpu-mcp-server
description: MCP server for NVIDIA GPU diagnostics in Kubernetes clusters
author: Eduardo Arango <arangogutierrez@gmail.com>
_distribution_note: This npm package provides a thin wrapper that downloads the pre-built Go binary for the current platform from GitHub Releases. It does NOT include platform-specific npm packages (@k8s-gpu-mcp-server/linux-x64, etc.). If the binary download fails (e.g., in air-gapped environments), use the container image instead: ghcr.io/arangogutierrez/k8s-gpu-mcp-server
